_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/AmalgamationPlates/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, three cells, the controller [0,0,0]: the head cell, at the front; the plates fall south, away from the player. No power and nothing moves: no powerCell and no driver, every part is still and fitted or drawn by its requires. The infeed is vanilla's chute section in the feed cell's top face, the outlet the same in the output cell's end face; the water line's inlet meets a ppex pipe end to end on the water face. buildStages: what each build stage adds, in order: the plates, the trap, then services (the chutes and the water line). The dressing is recurring, not a stage. amalgamStates: the amalgam on the plates, one drawn at a time. See the amalgamation plates' README for the schema.

pipes._comment: The spray pipe, ppex's straight pipe soldered, one part per metal (the same elements); only the supplied metal's is drawn.
